# Bidam's Rebellion rewrite (#40–#46)

Script: `scripts/.cache/rewrite/bidam.mjs` (8 phases, each marker-guarded; re-running prints `skip`). `DRY=1` chains every phase in memory and writes `/tmp/bidam-dry.json`.
Checks: `validate.mjs 40 46` → `ok #40–#46`. Anchor check: the 7 baseline breaks in range (Suro ×6, Seung ×1) are fixed; no new unmatched anchors. Images that followed moved text were moved into the destination entry's `images[]`; the thumbnails for #40, #42 and #44 stay in their own entries and were repointed.

Score: 108–108 through Day 5's flashback (Bidam the elder, "don't call me hyung when you're winning"); 109 at the duel. Headband: one history — father ties it (610), Bidam bloodies it on two seniors, offers it, Yushin refuses ("I will overcome it myself", #46 twist), Bidam keeps it in a chest (#40), wears it on Day 1, Yushin unties it from the body and lays it by the cup.

## Per episode

**#40 Gi** — Rebuilt around the Council veto as the climax of the first half and Day 1 as the end; Seungman is the cousin everywhere (prose, diagram, card, Yushin's line); Seungman's gate scene now costs something (she asks for one quiet winter, he refuses); screenplay directions and the transliteration line cut; Day 1 moved in from #42; the slogan became a Yumjong/Bidam scene with Bidam's ten-day plan; new dusk scene where Bidam tells a young officer what Gaya was. Cut: Takamuko opener, pillar flashback, appointment quote, Thirty-thousand quote, the old Seungman/Gesomun line. Logline updated.
- First line: "The Harmony Council has one rule. Nothing moves unless the circle closes. Everyone agrees, or nobody goes home."
- Card (19 words): "A sky that looks too long at a mountain. Six eggs. A red sail. Here is how Gaya began…!"

**#41 Suro** — Opening restatement trimmed; Ijinasi and the second birth line cut (one egg-box birth); Turtle-song verse and the duplicate map cut (quote kept); the Herald no longer answers himself (a villager does); Heo's eyes planted (paid off in #42 [eyes] and #45); tail returns to Day 2.
- First line unchanged (B).
- Card (18): "Nine days of grain. One folded note. Will the Marshal of Silla come to tea with a traitor…?"

**#42 Seung** — Now Days 2–5. Opens "Of course he comes." Alchun's absence exchange; Sadaham blood-whisper cut, Dukman given a line; Uso and the toad oddity fixed; Chunchu's islands line clarified; Haedong gloss, ten-li and Hyukgose lines trimmed (Hyukgose box stays closed); 정자 gloss and Heart Sutra quote cut; Munhee's Korean to 존댓말; grain counted each day; 108 flashback moved beside the score line and fixed so Bidam is the elder; new Day 5 ending: Bidam forces it, Yushin reluctantly reveals his grandfather sat the Baekje king on the camp stool at the Severing (no name, no 무력).
- First line: "Of course he comes. Yushin has never once refused Bidam a rematch."
- Card (19): "A cone helm, a king on a camp stool, and a name Yushin won’t say. Who was his grandfather…?"

**#43 Muryuk** — Rebuilt as one life in four scenes: the cart (looking back), the surrender bargain (Heewon's lines verbatim + "…Even south."), the Night Road (quote moved here from #45, Dodo returns the knife), the Last Gate (Muryuk talks Daegaya down; Sadaham's lines and anchors kept), the Name; returns to Day 6. 705 → 835 words. Logline updated.
- First line: "His name was Muryuk. He was the youngest of three sons in a cart, and the only one who looked back."
- Card (17): "Five days of grain. Two cups poured. Will the grandson of the cone helm come to tea…?"

**#44 Jeon** — Days 6–8. Headband flashback set to 610 with the punch; redundant "sixth night" line cut; Day 7 "nobody pours"; the Bidam cavern beat trimmed (one explicit sentence, the invitation line, the Lotus quote); kite quote cut; Hangyul's sacrifice moved to the Day 8 night; the ghost scene and Day 9 moved to #46; new ending "The Stone" with Chunchu, Yushin deciding to go down before light. Logline updated.
- First line unchanged (B).
- Card (22): "A warm stone, a spring under a hill, and a father who once got very lost on purpose. Who was Kim Seohyun…?"

**#45 Seohyun** — Lineage fixed (his father rode in the cart; Sukhuljong: "whose grandfather… in front of my grandfather"); five records cut, one moved to #43 (records now well under 20%); Manmyung's eyes line; the Daeyang paragraph trimmed; the closing paragraph now hands the stone to Yushin, cold for thirty years.
- First line unchanged (B).
- Card (20): "Ninth morning, before light. The stone in his son’s sleeve is warm at last. Down Yushin goes, to the water…!"

**#46 Gyeol** — Days 9–10. Opens on the warm stone; cavern + Narim's "So the stone woke you" + both ghost speeches verbatim (Muryuk named, look removed); Yumjong now dies on the page; Alchun's line no longer spoils Bidam's fall; Day 10 gate opens from the inside, the duel is staged blow by blow (dismount, yard drill, the cut at the brow, beads snag on the dragon ring, 99 beads in the mud). **Bidam dies once**: Kangrim reads the name while the body is still falling, asks his one question ("Were you a righteous traitor, or an unrighteous king?" — the father's words), Bidam answers, then "The body finishes falling after the name does." Second fall and the purge quote cut. Yushin kneels only to take the headband; flashback relabelled 610; headband laid by the cup. Logline updated.
- First line: "The water under the hill has been warm for thirty years. Before light on the ninth day, so is the stone in Yushin’s sleeve."
- Card unchanged (22): "The one hand that said no is gone. Now the crown has to fit Seungman, and it was made for someone else…!" → #47.

## Skipped, and why
- #41 tent scene not trimmed: a dozen stills anchor to those paragraphs; cutting would orphan them. #41 (1,560 words) and #44 (1,530) sit under the 2,000 sweet spot but are not stubs.
- #42 [72] keeps "春秋" in Bidam's mouth (it is his jab, not a gloss).
- Kangrim's new question replaces the old "opposite kite" line, which was not the "were you X, or Y?" form.

## Cross-range (for other owners)
- #1 [30] still calls Seungman the sister; #1 [57] "last time" may clash with the #46 bedside.
- #47 [5] says "Day 1 through Day 10" — still true, but the grain clock now reads 10→0 if #47 mentions it.
- #20 speaker names for the cone-helm man stay unnamed; #43 now owns his side of that night (camp stool, Dodo's knife).
- #21's cavern flashback still duplicates #45 (brief: one paragraph max there).
- The conscience water (Bupmin's jar, #42) has no plant before #42; #21 or #28 could seed it.
